## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Animated reasoning and tool disclosures (tools, ~3h, LOW/CONSIDER)

- **What**: Cline #13254 "feat(ui): add animated reasoning and tool disclosures" (merged 2026-08-18). Adds animated disclosure presentation (expand/collapse animations for reasoning blocks and tool call disclosures), `inert` support across React versions (disclosure content inert while animating to prevent interaction race conditions), animated disclosure component with height transitions, keyboard regression test for disclosure state. Pattern: animated height transitions on disclosure open/close, inert attribute during animation, disclosure component abstraction for reusable animation logic across reasoning and tool blocks. UI polish: smooth expand/collapse, prevents keyboard interactions during animation transitions, improves perceived performance.
- **Why**: Alexi TUI has disclosure state (ToolCallBlock.tsx L12 comments "disclosure state, status colors, terminal-style command output", ToolRow component delegates disclosure rendering) but NO animation (ToolCallBlock.tsx is thin wrapper around ToolRow, no animated height transitions, no inert during state changes). Cline's #13254 adds animated disclosure presentation for reasoning and tool calls — smoother UX, prevents interaction races during transitions. LOW priority: cosmetic improvement (animations polish existing disclosure functionality, no new capability), ~3h (add animated disclosure component with height transitions, apply to ToolRow, add inert support, test across React 19, verify no TUI render flash). CONSIDER: valuable UX polish but medium priority for CLI tool (desktop/VSCode benefit more from animations than terminal TUI), needs verification Alexi TUI would benefit (terminal rendering constraints differ from web DOM). Pattern portable (animated disclosure component abstraction) but ROI lower for CLI than desktop/VSCode. CONSIDER status: investigate if Ink supports animations well, then decide.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13254 "feat(ui): add animated reasoning and tool disclosures" (merged 2026-08-18). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13254. Adds animated disclosure presentation, inert support, height transitions, disclosure component abstraction.
- **Category**: tools (TUI disclosure animations). **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: LOW/CONSIDER (cosmetic improvement, existing disclosure state works, animation polish adds perceived performance, needs verification Ink supports animations well, ROI lower for CLI TUI than desktop/VSCode). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-18).
